title: Nice Crunchy Kenyan Beef Stir Fry
description: A jammy, crunchy, festive Kenyan dish featuring beef flank steak, stir-fry, and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the snow peas, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the peas are tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the beef is coated in the sauce.
Stir in the toasted sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Serve the beef and vegetable mixture hot over rice or noodles.
